title: Make it an actual binary clock
line: The Binary Clock has a new option to show hours, minutes and seconds as whole binary numbers instead of one binary column per digit.
explanation: The Binary Clock only shows binary-coded decimal: each decimal digit of the time gets its own four-light column, so 31 minutes is 0011 0001, and there was no way to see the time as real binary numbers. The new "Whole binary numbers instead of digits" option (off by default) shows hours, minutes and seconds as one six-light column each (3 columns x 6 rows, or 2 columns without seconds). The panel width calculation now also counts the spacing between columns, so the narrower grid keeps full-size dots in a panel.

commits.message:
applets/binary-clock: add an option to show whole numbers in binary

The clock could only show each decimal digit of the time in binary, so
31 minutes lit up as 0011 0001. A new option shows hours, minutes and
seconds as whole six-bit binary numbers, one column each, instead.

BUG: 521459

patches.diff:
From 15b51514f34053bff08e9ae4b543b618068cc88d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:47:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/binary-clock: add an option to show whole numbers in
 binary

The clock could only show each decimal digit of the time in binary, so
31 minutes lit up as 0011 0001. A new option shows hours, minutes and
seconds as whole six-bit binary numbers, one column each, instead.

BUG: 521459
---
 applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml   | 20 ++++++++++++--------
 applets/binary-clock/configGeneral.qml |  7 +++++++
 applets/binary-clock/main.xml          |  3 +++
 3 files changed, 22 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml b/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml
index 29e89342d..001f7fc3d 100644
--- a/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml
+++ b/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml
@@ -29,13 +29,13 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 Item {
     id: main
 
-    readonly property real w1: (main.height-5*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)*dots/4
+    readonly property real w1: (main.height-(rows+1)*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)*dots/rows+(dots+1)*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
 
     Layout.minimumWidth: w1 < 20 ? 20 : w1
     Layout.maximumWidth: Infinity
     Layout.preferredWidth: Layout.minimumWidth
 
-    Layout.minimumHeight: 16+(Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing*5)
+    Layout.minimumHeight: rows*4+(Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing*(rows+1))
     //Layout.maximumHeight: vertical ? Layout.minimumHeight : Infinity
     //Layout.preferredHeight: Layout.minimumHeight
 
@@ -51,12 +51,16 @@ Item {
 
     readonly property bool showOffLeds: Plasmoid.configuration.showOffLeds
 
-    readonly property int dots: Plasmoid.configuration.showSeconds ? 6 : 4
+    readonly property bool trueBinary: Plasmoid.configuration.trueBinary
+
+    readonly property int dots: (Plasmoid.configuration.showSeconds ? 3 : 2) * (trueBinary ? 1 : 2)
+
+    readonly property int rows: trueBinary ? 6 : 4
 
     readonly property color onColor: Plasmoid.configuration.useCustomColorForActive ? Plasmoid.configuration.customColorForActive : Kirigami.Theme.textColor
     readonly property color offColor: Plasmoid.configuration.useCustomColorForInactive ? Plasmoid.configuration.customColorForInactive : Qt.rgba(onColor.r, onColor.g, onColor.b, 0.2)
 
-    readonly property int dotSize: Math.min((height-5*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)/4, (width-(dots+1)*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)/dots)
+    readonly property int dotSize: Math.min((height-(rows+1)*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)/rows, (width-(dots+1)*Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)/dots)
 
     readonly property alias mouseArea: mouseArea
 
@@ -69,19 +73,19 @@ Item {
     GridLayout {
         anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
         anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
-        columns: Plasmoid.configuration.showSeconds ? 6 : 4
+        columns: main.dots
         Repeater {
-            model: [8, 4, 2, 1]
+            model: main.trueBinary ? [32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1] : [8, 4, 2, 1]
             Repeater {
                 id: bitRepeater
                 required property var modelData
-                model: [main.hours/main.base, main.hours%main.base, main.minutes/main.base, main.minutes%main.base, main.seconds/main.base, main.seconds%main.base]
+                model: main.trueBinary ? [main.hours, main.minutes, main.seconds] : [main.hours/main.base, main.hours%main.base, main.minutes/main.base, main.minutes%main.base, main.seconds/main.base, main.seconds%main.base]
                 property var bit: modelData
                 Rectangle {
                     required property var modelData
                     required property int index
                     property var timeVal: modelData
-                    visible: main.dotSize >= 0 && (main.Plasmoid.configuration.showSeconds || index < 4)
+                    visible: main.dotSize >= 0 && index < main.dots
                     width: main.dotSize
                     height: width
                     radius: width/2
diff --git a/applets/binary-clock/configGeneral.qml b/applets/binary-clock/configGeneral.qml
index 25ed78329..d61e8628c 100644
--- a/applets/binary-clock/configGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/binary-clock/configGeneral.qml
@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
     property bool cfg_showOffLeds
     property alias cfg_showSeconds: showSecondsCheckBox.checked
+    property alias cfg_trueBinary: trueBinaryCheckBox.checked
     property alias cfg_useCustomColorForActive: useCustomColorForActiveRadioButton.checked
     property alias cfg_customColorForActive: customColorForActive.color
     property alias cfg_useCustomColorForInactive: useCustomColorForInactiveRadioButton.checked
@@ -33,6 +34,12 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                     text: i18nc("@option:check completes Show …", "Seconds")
                 }
             }
+            Kirigami.FormEntry {
+                contentItem: QtControls.CheckBox {
+                    id: trueBinaryCheckBox
+                    text: i18nc("@option:check completes Show …", "Whole binary numbers instead of digits")
+                }
+            }
         }
 
         Kirigami.FormGroup {
diff --git a/applets/binary-clock/main.xml b/applets/binary-clock/main.xml
index 37d65e055..bf412ce4a 100644
--- a/applets/binary-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/binary-clock/main.xml
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@
     <entry name="showSeconds" type="Bool">
       <default>true</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="trueBinary" type="Bool">
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="useCustomColorForActive" type="Bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
--

media.caption: Master at 19:44:55: one column per decimal digit (1 9 | 4 4 | 5 5)
With the new option at 19:47:34: one column each for hours, minutes, seconds (010011 = 19, 101111 = 47, 100010 = 34)
Current master settings page (Kirigami.Form): no way to choose real binary
New 'Whole binary numbers instead of digits' option in the Show: group

review.text: Clean, minimal implementation of the requested true-binary mode for Binary Clock with an off-by-default KConfig option, a matching Kirigami.Form checkbox in the Show group, and updated 3x6 (or 2x6 without seconds) grid and width calculations. The screenshots verify both the settings UI and exact 6-bit binary output for 19:47:34 (010011, 101111, 100010), and BCD behavior remains intact.
